what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-steps 1-5: blue pins go into thin beams, the thin beams are pressed on the 11-hole beam, and the two numbered fairings (7 and 8) are clipped on the beam's ends.
where_everything_is_after: a finished 11-hole beam with two thin beams and two small black fairings is ready to be fitted next

why.problem_solved: Builds the first side-body piece with its cosmetic fairings.
why.why_these_parts: A long beam with pins gives mounting points; fairings 7 and 8 round off the shape.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 31 fits it to the model.

review_note: The booklet circles 7 and 8 refer to fairing part numbers. The pin type (43093 vs 42924) cannot be told apart in the sub-step pictures; both blue pins are read as 43093 from the parts box. This sub-build is not attached yet; attachment is in step 31.
